subject: Re: GPNR status: repro converging, reflective assets weak
body:
Team,

Q2 wrap decisions:

1. Milestone met — repro within 0.3dB and the on-demand preview quality bar passes for standard catalog assets. Reflective assets are explicitly out of scope for v1; the Q3 proposal lists them as the research risk.
2. Q3 proposal (to Hana May 15): a limited preview service behind the catalog UI, batch-rendered — 11s per frame is acceptable there.
3. Ingestion stays on Alina's plan — final IBRNet and catalog captures land the week of Jun 15, ahead of the Jun 26 corpus freeze. Carmen, please confirm validation coverage this week.

Nice quarter, everyone.

Lucia
